title: Los mexicas
goal: Read in depth about how the Mexica actually ran an empire, from the Triple Alliance to a temple rediscovered by accident, and explain why the scale of sacrifice is still debated.

items: Explain what the Triple Alliance actually was, and why 'Mexica empire' is a simplification.
Describe how tribute was recorded and what the Codex Mendoza shows.
Explain how chinampas made Tenochtitlan's food supply possible.
Describe how the Templo Mayor was rediscovered in 1978.
Use impersonal se to describe historical practices and estimates.
